newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-FEYENOORD DROP POINTS BUT STAY ON TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FEYENOORD DROP POINTS BUT STAY ON TOP.

text.p: Leaders Feyenoord Rotterdam were held to a 1-1 draw by lowly RKC Waalwijk in the Dutch first division on Saturday but reopened their two point lead over nearest challengers PSV Eindhoven.

PSV had fared no better in their away match against Fortuna Sittard on Friday, also having to settle for a 1-1 draw after playing the last hour of the match with only 10 men after goalkeeper Ronald Waterreus was sent off for handling the ball outside the box.
RKC, who sacked their trainer Kees van Kooten earlier on the day, took the lead two minutes before halftime through Adilson dos Santos.
The goal appeared to spur the visitors into action and their efforts were rewarded in the 57th minute when Giovanni van Bronckhorst equalised after a defensive mistake.
It left Feyenoord top of the table with 23 points from 10 games with PSV on 21.
